recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a dead-man's-switch heartbeat: add one ping to nightly-sync after it succeeds, sent to healthchecks.io (free tier) or to a self-hosted healthchecks container on the Synology, so the user gets a text or email if no ping arrives by 03:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to know when nightly-sync fails; the real ask is "alert me if it doesn't finish," not "store logs I can browse."
labels.Deleted: A Synology Docker log stack (Loki/ELK/etc.) — you said you won't read logs, so a place to read logs doesn't fix the problem that broke last week.
labels.Bottleneck: There's no failure/completion signal at all, not a lack of log storage — the crash happened before the email step, so nothing fired.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me — four silent startup crashes, email-on-success is the only existing signal, no monitoring exists today.

note: The core advice is one heartbeat alert, but the reply also offers a self-hosted healthchecks container on the Synology (Docker) as an option to set up now, and the rubric counts that as LARGER.
